design_rationale: The authors describe the study as a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in which eligible pregnant women were allocated to one of three groups following randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study states participants were randomized, but the method of random sequence generation and allocation concealment is not reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Pregnant women were included in a randomized, double-blind trial... After randomization there were 31 in the HI-group, 30 in the Non-HI-group, and 29 in the placebo group.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and healthcare providers were blinded using a double-dummy technique, tablet masking was successful, and analyses followed the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A double dummy technique was used to mask tablets. The caretakers (midwives and doctors) were not aware of any outcome variables other than Hb values... There were no significant differences between groups concerning the women's belief about the content of the tablets they were receiving.

domain_judgments.rationale: Missing outcome data proportions were low to moderate (around 20%), balanced across intervention groups, and reasons for missingness were documented and similar between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Missing data mainly due to non attendance were evenly distributed between groups throughout the study and at the end of the study there were complete data from 24 (77%), 24 (82%) and 23 (79%) women in the HI, Non-HI and the placebo group respectively.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective hematological and biochemical laboratory markers measured using standard automated and blinded laboratory methods unlikely to be influenced by knowledge of intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All analyses were performed in the Laboratory of Clinical Biochemistry in Haukeland University Hospital, regularly undergoing quality controls within international programs... Red cell indices were measured on an automatic hematology analyzer (Coulter STKS, Coulter Company, Miami, USA). S-ferritin concentration was measured with a microparticle enzyme immuno assay technique...

domain_judgments.rationale: No prospective trial registration or pre-published analysis protocol is mentioned, leaving some concerns regarding potential selective reporting of specific timepoints and analyses.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Blood samples from all participants were analyzed at entry (before the 13th week), in weeks 19–21, 27–29, 37–39, 6–10 weeks postpartum (pp) and half a year pp for the following parameters: Red cell indices (Hb, erythrocytes, hematocrit, MCV, MCH, MCHC), reticulocytes, s-iron, Total Iron Binding Capacity (TIBC), s-ferritin and erythrocyte protoporphyrin (E-PP).

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is rated as some concerns, driven by unclear allocation concealment and sequence generation details in Domain 1, as well as the lack of a pre-registered trial analysis protocol in Domain 5.

design_rationale: The study is described as a triple-blind, randomized clinical trial where eligible pregnant women were randomly allocated to receive either ferrous sulfate or placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although participants were randomly allocated and bottles were numbered, the specific method of sequence generation and allocation concealment details are not described, and there was a baseline difference in age between groups (p = .02).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: eligible women (hemoglobin > 110 g/L, serum ferritin > 20 µg/L) were randomly allocated to receive one tablet orally per day containing either 60 mg of iron ... or placebo (n = 78) until delivery. ... A label on each bottle included a number linking the bottle to the type of tablet.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants, physicians, and laboratory staff were successfully blinded with indistinguishable placebos, and there were no reported deviations from the intended intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The placebos were formulated to be indistinguishable from the tablets containing iron. ... The physician, laboratory analysts, and subjects were not aware of the type of tablet.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study allocated 148 women (70 iron, 78 placebo), but does not clearly account for complete participant flow or clarify whether all randomized women or only full-term deliveries were analyzed for all outcomes (with abortions noted), raising some concerns for missing outcome data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We found one case of pregnancy-induced hypertension and three cases of abortion in the iron group and one case of abortion in the placebo group (data not shown).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective laboratory and anthropometric measures assessed by blinded laboratory analysts and clinical personnel using standard methods.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin concentration was measured with a Coulter electronic counter, model K-800. Serum ferritin was measured by a radioimmunoassay with a Gamacounter, model 1001. ... The physician, laboratory analysts, and subjects were not aware of the type of tablet.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered in the Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials, and all prespecified maternal iron status and infant birth outcomes are reported according to the analysis plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study protocol was approved by the Ethics Committee of Lorestan University of Medical Sciences (IRCT ID: IRCT138706141196N1).

overall_summary: The overall judgment is some concerns, driven by unclear allocation sequence generation and concealment methods in Domain 1 (along with a baseline age imbalance) and lack of detailed reporting on participant flow and handling of dropouts/losses to follow-up in Domain 3.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated using a computer-generated randomization schedule with balanced blocks and stratification.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants, carers, and study personnel were successfully blinded using identical placebo tablets, and analysis adhered to intention-to-treat principles.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Trial participants and the research team were unaware of the group assignment. At 6 wk postpartum, the women were asked to guess their assigned treatment group. The trial was unblinded after the analysis of primary outcomes.

domain_judgments.rationale: Sequence generation was computer-generated by an independent consultant and allocation was concealed using centrally coded opaque bottles prepared by the pharmacy department.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A computer-generated randomization schedule, with balanced blocks and stratified for parity (first pregnancy to reach 20 wk of gestation or second or subsequent pregnancy to reach 20 wk of gestation), was generated by an independent consultant. Opaque bottles with childproof lids were marked with a sequential, numerical code and were filled according to the randomization schedule by the Pharmacy Department at Women’s & Children’s Hospital.

domain_judgments.rationale: Data were available for the vast majority of participants (>85-90%), with balanced attrition across arms and evidence that missingness was unrelated to participant characteristics.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: At the time of delivery, 200/216 (94%) and 193/214 (90%) maternal hemoglobin samples were available from the iron-supplemented and placebo groups, respectively, and 186/216 (86%) and 176/214 (82%) ferritin samples were available... There were no significant differences in social or demographic characteristics between the women who successfully completed the trial and those with missing data for primary outcome measures.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were assessed using objective, standardized automated laboratory assays and validated questionnaires while outcome assessors remained blinded.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin concentrations were measured spectrophotometrically by using a Cell Dyn 4000 analyzer (Abbott Laboratories, Santa Clara, CA), and serum ferritin was determined by a microparticle enzyme immunoassay on an AxSYM Automated Analyzer (Abbott Laboratories, Abbott Park, IL). Analyses were completed within 3 h of collection by the Department of Hematology at Women’s and Children’s Hospital.

domain_judgments.rationale: All pre-specified primary and secondary outcomes were analyzed and reported according to standard, predefined statistical methods.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Primary outcomes were the incidence of maternal IDA at delivery, maternal iron status at 6 mo postpartum, and gastrointestinal side effects at 24 and 36 wk of gestation. Secondary outcomes were... All available data were used for intention-to-treat analyses.

overall_summary: The study is a well-designed, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial with central concealment of allocation, high follow-up rates, blinded outcome assessments, and low risk of bias across all RoB 2 domains.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to iron supplement or placebo groups using a computerized random number generator algorithm.

domain_judgments.rationale: Computerized random sequence generation was used with proper allocation concealment maintained by an off-site data manager who held the allocation code.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The women were randomly allocated to treatment groups on the basis of random numbers generated by the study data manager using a computerized algorithm (STATVIEW II; Abacus Concepts, Inc, Berkeley, California)... The data manager (who did not have contact with patients) assigned participants to their groups and held the link. WIC personnel, laboratory analysts, and patients were not aware of the type of capsules.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blinding was successfully maintained with identical placebo capsules, and analyses were conducted according to original randomized groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The capsules containing placebo were formulated to be indistinguishable from those containing iron, and at the first visit, each subject was given a bottle containing a 31-d supply of either the placebo or the iron capsules... WIC personnel, laboratory analysts, and patients were not aware of the type of capsules.

domain_judgments.rationale: A substantial proportion of participants (22.5% for birth weight, 28.7% for hematologic outcomes) had missing outcome data, though sensitivity analysis using multiple imputation showed consistent results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Seventy-nine women (28.7%) were missing data on third-trimester iron status, 62 (22.5%) were missing data on infant birth weight, and 43 (15.6%) were missing data on both... We compared our complete case analysis (n = 213) with that obtained by using a 3-step multiple imputation process (n = 275)... and found that the reductions in low birth weight in the iron supplement group were substantial regardless of the assumption.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes (laboratory assays for iron status, standard program records for birth weight) were objectively measured and outcome assessors/analysts were blinded to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Birth weight, birth length, and date of delivery were obtained from the WIC program records... Laboratory analysts, and patients were not aware of the type of capsules.

domain_judgments.rationale: Birth weight and gestational age were added as outcomes post hoc during the conduct of the trial rather than being specified in an original pre-registered trial protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: During the study, we added birth weight and gestational age as outcomes because of a need for more information on the functional consequences of iron supplementation during pregnancy (1, 2).

overall_summary: The study is judged to have some concerns overall due to notable loss to follow-up (over 20% missing outcome data for primary and birth outcomes) and the post-hoc addition of key birth outcomes during the course of the study.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated in a 1:1 ratio to receive daily iron or placebo (with folate) using a random-number chart generated by an independent statistician.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated via a random-number chart by an independent statistician, allocation was concealed through pre-numbered identical packs, and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Taiyuan Satellite Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. prepared equal quantities of iron or placebo capsules and folate capsules and assigned 4-digit package numbers beginning with 0001 according to a random-number chart prepared by a statistician who was not part of the study. Study participants, personnel, and investigators were unaware of supplement group.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants, study personnel, and investigators were successfully double-blinded using identical capsules, and primary analyses were conducted according to intention-to-treat principles.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Study participants, personnel, and investigators were unaware of supplement group. The code was not broken until the study and primary analyses were completed. ... Primary analyses were based on intention-to-treat.

domain_judgments.rationale: Over 31% of participants were lost to follow-up without outcome data, raising some concerns despite similar attrition rates across arms and baseline comparability of those with and without missing outcome data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Attrition affected the groups similarly both in proportion [31.8% (377 of 1186) in the placebo/folate group and 30.5% (362 of 1185) in the iron/folate group] and reason. Most attrition [87.5% (647 of 739)] was due to delivery at a nonparticipating hospital/health center. ... Iron status at enrollment was similar for those with and without outcome data.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective hematological and biochemical laboratory assays performed according to standard protocols with quality controls by staff blinded to intervention status.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A complete blood count, including hemoglobin and mean corpuscular volume (MCV), was performed by using a Sysmex KX-21N Auto Hematology Analyzer ... ZPP/H was analyzed by hematofluorometer (Aviv Biomedical), serum ferritin (SF) and serum transferrin receptor (sTfR) by chemiluminescent immunoassay (Beckman Coulter Access 2 Immunoassay System), and serum C-reactive protein (CRP) by rate nephelometry (Hitachi 7600). Both laboratories maintained standard quality-control procedures.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was registered and reported all pre-specified maternal and neonatal hematological and birth outcomes according to standard analytical definitions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This trial was registered at clinicaltrials.gov as NCT02221752. ... Primary outcomes were as follows: 1) maternal iron deficiency (ID) ... 2) maternal ID anemia ... and 3) neonatal ID ... Other outcomes were maternal anemia and infant gestational age and birth weight.

overall_summary: The trial was well-conducted and double-blinded with objective laboratory measurements, but high attrition (>31% missing outcome data due to deliveries at nonparticipating hospitals) warrants some concerns for missing outcome data.

design_rationale: The authors describe the study as a 'randomised, double-blind, placebo controlled study of 207 healthy women (100 iron treated, 107 placebo treated) and their newborn babies'.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial is described as randomized and baseline characteristics between groups appear comparable, no details regarding sequence generation or allocation concealment methods are reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The design of the study was randomised, double-blind, placebo controlled. It included 248 females attending the Birth Clinic in 1985, within the 14th to 18th week of pregnancy.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind and placebo-controlled, but 41 randomized participants (16.5%) were post-randomization exclusions (per-protocol analysis of uncomplicated pregnancies) rather than analyzed according to intention-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The design of the study was randomised, double-blind, placebo controlled... Of the 248 females, 20 placebo and 21 iron treated were excluded for the following causes: withdrawn consent, 10; uterine bleeding episodes, 5; placental insufficiency, placenta praevia and abruptio placentae, 7; praeoclampsia, 3; partus praematurus, 5; excessive smoking (≥ 10 cigarettes/day), 3.

domain_judgments.rationale: Of 248 randomized women, 41 were excluded post-randomization, and several key iron status outcomes were only measured in a subset of 120 women without clear explanation of how the subset was selected.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In all 207 females, Hb and red cell volume (MCV) were determined on Coulter-S... In 120 females (63 iron and 57 placebo treated), S-iron, S-transferrin and transferrin saturation were measured... S-ferritin by a radioimmunoassay... and S-EPO by radioimmunoassay.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objective laboratory/biochemical measurements assessed via standardized automated and radioimmunoassay assays with double-blinding maintained.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In all 207 females, Hb and red cell volume (MCV) were determined on Coulter-S (Hb g/l × 0.0621 = Hb mmol/l), and S-HPL by radioimmunoassay. In 120 females (63 iron and 57 placebo treated), S-iron, S-transferrin and transferrin saturation were measured by previously described methods (10), S-ferritin by a radioimmunoassay (Ferritin RIA Amersham), and S-EPO by radioimmunoassay (11).

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no prospective trial registration or published pre-specified protocol available, leaving some concern regarding selection of reported analyses and cut-points.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In statistical analysis, the significance of differences was assessed by Mann-Whitney's rank sum test for paired and unpaired values, and correlations by Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (rs).

overall_summary: The study has some concerns overall due to lack of reporting on sequence generation and allocation concealment methods, post-randomization exclusions of complicated pregnancies, testing of key biochemical markers in an unexplained subgroup, and absence of a pre-registered protocol.
